blocks.text: Explains the two data sources (user_plans row, then plans.json defaults), the billing-anniversary roll-forward rule, the 'canceled' and 'past_due' policy, and the RLS defense-in-depth from eo/db.py.
blocks.title: Module docstring

blocks.text: _config loads plans.json (path overridable via PLANS_CONFIG_PATH), validates that default_plan is present in the plans dict and that credits_per_usd is positive, then caches the result for the process lifetime. reload_config() calls _config.cache_clear() for tests or live-reload.
blocks.title: Cached config loader

blocks.text: PlanState is a frozen dataclass holding all resolved plan fields including the final period_start/period_end (after roll-forward). The 'configured' bool distinguishes a row-backed state from a plans.json default. _as_utc coerces naive datetimes to UTC.
blocks.title: PlanState and UTC helpers

blocks.text: _add_months shifts a datetime by a whole number of months by computing the target year/month from the absolute month index and clamping the day to the month's length. effective_window uses it to roll the stored window forward by counting months elapsed since period_start and searching for the smallest offset whose result still contains now.
blocks.title: Calendar-month arithmetic

blocks.anchor: def default_state(user_id: str, now: "datetime | None" = None) -> PlanState:
blocks.text: default_state builds a PlanState from plans.json defaults with a calendar-month window and configured=False. state_from_row builds from the DB row: it calls effective_window to get the current period, then swaps in the default plan key and pool when status is 'canceled'.
blocks.title: default_state and state_from_row

blocks.anchor: def resolve_plan(user_id: str, now: "datetime | None" = None) -> PlanState:
blocks.text: Opens a user-scoped DB cursor, queries user_plans for the user's row (plan_key, credit_pool, period_start, period_end, status), and delegates to state_from_row if a row is found, else default_state. Raises on DB failure; callers choose their own error posture.
blocks.title: Main entry point

gotchas: No billing job exists yet — the period rolls forward in memory only; the DB row is never updated by this module
A 'canceled' plan loses its custom pool and falls back to plans.json defaults; 'past_due' keeps its pool
_config is cached forever per process; call reload_config() after editing plans.json in a long-running server
how_it_works: _config loads and validates plans.json once (functools.lru_cache), checking that default_plan is in plans and that credits_per_usd is positive
effective_window rolls a stored period forward by whole calendar months using _add_months until the window contains now, without writing back
resolve_plan opens a DB cursor scoped to user_id, fetches the user_plans row, and delegates to state_from_row or default_state
state_from_row applies effective_window and falls back to the default plan key/pool when status is 'canceled'
inputs: optional now (datetime) for testable time injection
plans.json via PLANS_CONFIG_PATH env var or the default path
outputs: PlanState frozen dataclass with user_id, plan_key, status, credit_pool, period_start, period_end, configured
purpose: Answers three questions for any account: which plan key applies, how large the credit pool is, and which time window the pool covers right now. It consults the user_plans table first, and falls back to plans.json defaults for unconfigured accounts. When a stored period has expired it rolls the window forward by whole months from the original period_start, so an account is never stuck in a permanently-expired window.
side_effects: Reads plans.json from disk on first call (_config)
summary: Resolves an account's current subscription plan, credit pool, and billing period without a billing job.

raises: ValueError if default_plan is not in plans or credits_per_usd is not positive
FileNotFoundError / JSON errors if the file is missing or malformed
side_effects: reads plans.json from disk on first call
symbols.summary: Loads and validates plans.json once per process, caching the result; respects the PLANS_CONFIG_PATH environment variable.
Frozen dataclass representing a fully resolved subscription state: plan key, status, credit pool size, and the current billing window.

symbols.details: Converts to an absolute month index (year*12 + month-1), adds the offset, converts back to year/month, and uses monthrange to clamp the day. Jan 31 + 1 month = Feb 28/29; Jan 31 + 2 months = Mar 31.

params.desc: starting datetime; its day of month drives the clamping
params.name: anchor

params.desc: number of whole months to advance (must be non-negative in practice)
params.name: months

symbols.returns: new datetime with year/month/day adjusted, all other fields unchanged
symbols.summary: Returns anchor shifted by a given number of whole calendar months, clamping the day to the target month's length.

symbols.details: If now is before period_end, returns the stored window unchanged. Otherwise computes the minimum number of months from period_start such that the resulting window contains now.

params.desc: stored billing window start (naive datetimes are assumed UTC)
params.name: period_start

params.desc: the current time to find the window for
params.name: now

symbols.summary: Returns the billing period window that contains now, rolling the stored window forward by whole months if it has expired.

params.desc: current time; defaults to UTC now if None
params.name: now

symbols.returns: PlanState with configured=False and the default plan's pool
symbols.summary: Builds a PlanState from plans.json defaults for an account with no user_plans row, using a calendar-month window.
